newsitem.title: USA: Marquette Medical incoming orders strong.
newsitem.headline: Marquette Medical incoming orders strong.

text.p: Marquette Medical Systems Inc said on Monday it continues to experience a strong incoming order rate for all its divisions.

"We attribute the strong orders to both added depth to our product line from the introduction of products at lower price points, and development of products for use in new care areas," Timothy Mickelson, president, said in a statement.
He added Marquette is expanding globally to capitalize on increasing international demand for health care technology.
Marquette makes medical equipment and systems for diagnostic cardiology, patient monitoring and integration of clinical information.

Earlier, Marquette reported fiscal third quarter earnings of $0.37 a share, compared with a year ago loss of $1.89 after a $35.7 million charge. Excluding this charge, it earned $0.31 in the 1995 third quarter.
Gross profit for the quarter was $67.5 million, up from $53.6 million a year ago. Gross margins rose to 49 percent for the quarter from 48.6 percent a year ago.
